notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 45 pieces over 26 lines.
The leg sub-assembly (pages 10-13) is built twice, as b32-b37 and b38-b43. It is shown in the booklet before steps 17 and 18, but listed after step 16 here.
Some steps (6, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16) show pieces being added without a callout. I inferred which pieces they are and how they stack from the pictures and the parts list.
The curved 11477 on each arm covers the clip plate and the hinge plate. rests_on records both.

The booklet does not clearly show where the eyes mount. I assumed each eye sits on the stud of a dark red jumper plate. The light grey 14704 socket plates are used as the hips for the legs' ball joints.
The booklet does not show how the flames attach in step 19. I assumed they attach at the back of the 11211 brick.
The 3665 foot slope is added from below the 14417 plate, so the link is recorded in other_joins. The plate is placed first, so its rests_on stays empty.
position is left null as requested.
Piece counts match the 105-piece parts list: 18 body + 2x8 rear (haunch) legs + 2x12 front (claw) legs + 4x5 feet + 22 head + 3 minifig-accessory pieces + sticker sheet + trading card.

Minifigure body parts (head, torso, legs, armour, green round piece) are on page 2 but are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded. Only the sword, 1L bar and shield from the list are included. In step 14 the minifigure sits on the body, so I joined the 1L bar (the minifigure's accessory) to the body bracket b19 and the shield to the bar as an assumption.

The trading card (b105) is never used or attached in the booklet. To keep the graph in one group it is recorded as a loose pairing with the sticker sheet (b104). That join is an assumption and not a physical connection. The sticker sheet is joined to the pieces it decorates.

Ids follow booklet order: page 2 minifig accessories, body (pp3-6), rear legs A and B (pp7-14), front legs C and D (pp15-24), 4 feet (p25), head (pp27-30). The final steps 9-14 only attach sub-assemblies, so they are recorded as other_joins.

The pictures are small and ambiguous in places. The exact rests_on choices for the body plates (which 2x2 section the rear balls, handle plate and wedge sit on), the head brackets and the arch/curved pieces of the leg are best guesses. The piece types and counts are certain.
In the front-leg claw step the second 49668 tooth plate goes underneath the hip plate. It has no piece below it, so it is joined by an other_join rather than rests_on.
Stickers go on the leg curved bricks, the feet curved slopes and the head. Only one or two representative sticker joins are recorded.
